covers: JSE morning session and overnight markets to about 10:20 SAST on Thursday 12 November 2026
headline: Breaking: Nvidia board meeting on Jensen Huang's future runs into the evening with no decision; Nasdaq futures slide again and the JSE trades 0.3% lower
summary: The JSE All Share was at 113,084.44 (-0.3%) and the Top 40 at 105,116.72 (-0.4%) at 10:04 SAST, with gold miners Harmony, AngloGold Ashanti and Gold Fields down about 2.5-3% and Naspers and Prosus down about 1.3% (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026). In the US, CNBC headlines say Nvidia's board meeting on CEO Jensen Huang stretched into the evening without a decision and Nasdaq-100 futures slid as the Nvidia sell-off resumed, while Treasury yields edged higher ahead of inflation data (CNBC headlines, 12 Nov 2026). The rand was at R16.62/$ and gold at $3,970.10, both weaker as the dollar holds near a 19-month high on Fed rate-hike bets (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026; Investing.com headline, 12 Nov).

items.title: Nvidia board meeting on Jensen Huang's future stretches into the evening
items.summary: A CNBC headline published at 08:11 SAST says the Nvidia board meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang's fate stretched into the evening (US time) — so no decision had been reported at that point. We could not open the article for detail on the board's reasons, any company statement or a successor. Nvidia last closed at $173.73 (+2.9%) on 11 Nov before falling 8-9% after hours on the original Wall Street Journal report (see Morning brief).
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 08:11 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 23:00 SAST

items.title: Nasdaq-100 futures slide as the Nvidia sell-off resumes
items.summary: An updated CNBC live-updates headline at 09:53 SAST says Nasdaq-100 futures were sliding, dragged lower as the Nvidia sell-off resumed. We could not open the page for futures levels. The US open at 16:30 SAST is the next test.

items.title: Treasury yields edge higher before inflation and housing data
items.summary: A CNBC headline at 09:38 SAST says Treasury yields edged higher as investors await fresh inflation and housing data. The 10-year yield closed at 4.998% on 11 Nov. We could not open the article for this morning's levels.
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026

items.title: UK economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter
items.summary: A CNBC headline at 10:02 SAST says the UK economy expanded 0.7% in the third quarter, with AI described as an 'extra engine of growth'. We could not open the article for the forecast or monthly figures.

items.title: Wednesday's close for reference: S&P 500 7,619.38, Nasdaq 25,466.19
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed 1.3% higher and the Nasdaq Composite 1.6% higher on 11 Nov, before the Nvidia news hit futures.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 close

items.title: JSE 0.3% lower in early trade; gold miners lead the fall
items.summary: At 10:04 SAST the All Share was at 113,084.44 (-0.3% from 113,449.53) and the Top 40 at 105,116.72 (-0.4% from 105,558.44). Harmony was at R259.93 (-3.1%), AngloGold Ashanti R1,493.56 (-2.9%) and Gold Fields R606.60 (-2.5%) as gold slipped; Naspers was at R744.79 (-1.3%) and Prosus R675.11 (-1.3%). Banks were firmer, with FirstRand R97.29 (+0.9%) and Nedbank R297.37 (+1.1%). Woolworths was at R37.66 (-0.3%) after Wednesday's 8.5% fall.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 10:04 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 09:49 SAST

items.title: Rand softer ahead of mining production data
items.summary: Reuters and Mining.com.au headlines say the rand softened ahead of Stats SA's mining production figures due today. It was at R16.62/$ at 10:04 SAST, against R16.60 earlier this morning and R16.48/$ a week ago. We could not open the articles for the expected mining numbers.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 10:04 SAST; Reuters headline, 12 Nov 2026 08:20 SAST

items.title: Gold $3,970.10, below $4,000; platinum $1,544.60
items.summary: Gold was at $3,970.10 this morning, down from Wednesday's $3,984.20 close, and platinum at $1,544.60. A Moneyweb headline says gold is holding below $4,000 as the market looks ahead to a Fed rate hike. We could not open the article.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 10:04 SAST; Moneyweb headline, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Oil lower on peace-talk hopes and rising supply; copper about $13,741/t
items.summary: Moneyweb and Investing.com headlines say oil fell toward a two-month low on hopes for Iran and Ukraine peace talks and rising Middle East production; a separate headline says the US Energy Information Administration raised its 2026 crude price forecasts. Our price feeds give conflicting Brent readings this morning, so we leave out a level until we can confirm it. Copper was at about $13,741 a tonne.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 10:04 SAST; Moneyweb, Investing.com and MarketForces Africa headlines, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia: no board decision yet on the CEO
items.summary: The board meeting on Jensen Huang's future ran into the evening without a reported decision, and futures point to a further fall at the open (CNBC headlines, see Breaking). Moneyweb carries a headline that AMD, Broadcom and Alphabet are poised to gain from the Nvidia scandal; we could not open it. Our BUY rating and fair value of $262.56 are unchanged (LRC Watchlist); news reports do not change the rating. Results are due 17 November.
items.source: CNBC and Moneyweb headlines, 12 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist

items.summary: A CNBC headline says Meta's head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by a former AWS cloud executive; we could not open the article for names. Meta closed at $628.77 (-2.0%) on 11 Nov. Our SELL rating and fair value of $677.14 are unchanged (LRC Watchlist).
